_meta.what: Outreach sequences started from desk signals, with every touch, reply and meeting logged — the outcomes loop. Rates are computed from this file.
_meta.how: python -m intel.outreach start <N°> | touch <id> <step> | reply <id> | meeting <id> | outcome <id> won|declined|parked | report [--email]

sequences.role: Chief Commercial and Partner Officer, Druva

touches.purpose: Welcome to the role; the team and the open lane; the 25-minute ask.
LinkedIn connect with a one-line note on the team.
Follow up with the calendar window and the season's first activation moment.
Send the case page: value to the team, deal architecture, precedent.
Call; offer a 25-minute walk-through of the lane before their plan is set.
Close the loop; ask for their planning cycle and the right month to return.
